Episodes.Title: Get Your Guns Out
Episodes.Description: Max lands in trouble when El Cano operatives swarm around her, while Andres' team discovers there are more children being held captive.

Episodes.Title: Heart of Darkness
Episodes.Description: Caught in a perilous shoot-out, Gabriel and Tomas take a moment to make peace. Meanwhile, Andres attempts to honor a child's request.

Episodes.Title: This Time for Heroes
Episodes.Description: Greg and the gang try to lure Manuel and the rest of El Cano out with threats of gunfire. But when they're nowhere to be seen, the team gets suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Bad Time to Die
Episodes.Description: Danger continues as the team spots bomb traps in the buildings. Greg realizes the El Cano is using a sinister weapon for deadly attacks.

Episodes.Title: Kontraktwalistas
Episodes.Description: Andres and Tomas attempt to rescue a teammate in trouble as El Cano forces threaten to gun them down. JB's condition puts him and Max in a bind.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: As JB and Max try to escape El Cano operatives, they must fend off Manuel's right hand man. Meanwhile Miguel helps out Gabriela.

Episodes.Title: Exit Point
Episodes.Description: While JB and Max continue the fight against Manuel's henchman, Greg confronts an old friend to finish the mission once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Love and Honor
Episodes.Description: As Greg vows to take down El Cano, Gabriela discuss their relationship, while Andres gets a visitor he wasn't expecting.

Entries.Title: Saving Grace
Entries.Description: Anna, an elementary school teacher, discovers that her student Grace is a victim of abuse. Driven by maternal instinct, Anna abducts Grace to protect her and assumes the role of a mother. As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Anna, an emotionally distant teacher, determinedly prepares for an opportunity abroad. However, an unexpected turn of events leads her to meet Grace, a young student suffering from abuse. As she grows closer to the young girl, Anna becomes torn between pursuing her dreams and saving Grace from her abusive parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Anna rescues Grace and accompanies her to Quezon, but they face numerous setbacks along the way. The news of Grace's disappearance reaches public affairs host Miranda Valdez, who then shows interest in the story to save her program. Meanwhile, Chito gets questioned by the authorities about the possible abuse of the missing child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Anna and Grace find refuge in Lucia's abandoned orphanage. While Anna works to provide for their needs, her past catches up with her when Miranda, Detective Oscar and TV producer Julius investigate her involvement in the missing girl's case. As the pressure of investigation mounts and Lucia's vindictive son looms eviction, Anna faces a heart-wrenching decision for Grace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tension rises when the police locate Lucia's orphanage and Sarah catches sight of her daughter, Grace. Luckily, Grace manages to escape while Sarah is left bewildered by her action. Left with no other option, Anna takes Grace to Palawan and seeks help from her adoptive mother, Helena. However, family tensions rise, threatening to expose Anna's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: To protect Grace, Anna is forced to pretend that the former is her child and divert the police investigation away from her. However, Julius relentlessly asks questions who the child's father is, while Helena starts to doubt her supposed granddaughter's identity. Soon, a heated confrontation compels Anna to reveal her long-buried secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After discovering that Anna is hiding Grace, Julius forces them to surrender. However, an accident strands them in a deserted house where Anna and Grace reveal to Julius the whole truth behind their actions. Tensions escalate at the Sarmientos' inn as Miranda, Oscar, Sarah, and Chito become more suspicious of Anna compelling her to choose between Grace and her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Helena urges Anna to return Grace to her mother, while Sarah's persistent harassment causes an accident at the Sarmiento's inn. Julius helps Anna and Grace hide, but Jessica soon finds their shelter and gets incriminating evidence against Anna. Meanwhile, a stolen bracelet leads Miranda to uncover a shocking truth about someone she has been searching for over the years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After discovering Anna's past, an unjust manipulation of their interview compels Miranda to choose between helping Anna and protecting her career. A heated confrontation between Miranda and Helena causes past pains to resurface. Grace's and Anna's safety are put at risk when Princess makes a reckless decision and Julius' father discovers his involvement in the missing girl's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Despite managing to escape Palawan with her help, Anna struggles to fully trust Miranda. Meanwhile, Miranda receives a startling news that makes her determined to set things right for Anna. While the television host works to clear Anna's name and exposes Sarah's true nature, Sarah finds someone's help to fight back Miranda, raising suspicions about who might be hiding Anna.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Helena is desperate to keep Anna away from Miranda, fearing that their growing bond will unravel her dark secrets. Anna, determined to flee with Grace, considers questionable means when their hideout gets discovered. Jessica's actions become more unpredictable, while Sarah's growing suspicions intensify the looming threat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Oscar closes in on Grace and Anna, Erin's resurfacing memories reveal the root of Anna's painful past. Princess' betrayal prompts the Sarmientos to uncover a life-altering truth about Helena. In a selfless move, Miranda makes a sacrifice that will put her career and reputation in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Anna's world crumbles when she discovers a long-buried family secret. Miranda entrusts Grace with the key to her shared past with Anna and tries to protect her secret at all costs. However, a revenge-driven Sarah exposes a startling revelation that threatens to break Anna and Miranda's fragile bond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Despite Miranda's struggle with her worsening condition, Anna finds it difficult to forgive her biological mother. However, a sudden discovery leads to Anna's change of heart. As everyone continues to search for Grace, the accused teacher faces harassment and serious charges in court—until an unexpected arrival seemingly changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Grace does everything she can to help Anna, only to hear that she has to stay in a shelter for her safety and well-being. Meanwhile, Sarah's anger fuels her relentless drive to win Grace back, leading her to make a desperate attempt to reclaim her daughter. As tensions escalate, Anna makes a bold and unexpected move to save Grace.

Entries.Title: Brothers
Entries.Description: Ador is a well known and respected CIDG Police Official, with a loving family as his support. Cardo, on the other hand, loves the solitude of the mountains in the province as a SAF Trooper. Their lives take a sudden turn when Ador gets himself entangled in a syndicate by being betrayed by one of his own colleagues, resulting to his death. To conceal this fact, Cardo was ordered to pretend to be Ador and finish the mission what his brother left behind. He will also be force to pretend to his brother's family and friends, and be re-united with his grandmother, whom he despised, for assuming she abandoned him.

Entries.Title: Batang Quiapo
Entries.Description: A young man rises to be one of the biggest outlaws in the neighborhood while he navigates his way in life to survive in Quiapo. Hoping to earn the affection of his parents, his feat draws him closer to the truth about his identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Wanting to prove his worth as a crime lord's son, Ramon sets out to accomplish a bank robbery right in the middle of bustling Quiapo. When things do not go as planned, however, Ramon makes a decision to save his legacy through violence and assault.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Oblivious to his true identity, Tanggol grows up constantly trying to earn his parents' affection despite receiving familial love from his grandmother. Years later, he becomes a notorious outlaw in the neighborhood.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Ramon ends up spending years in prison but eventually manages to establish his power among the inmates. Tanggol gets involved in a riot after coming to his brother's rescue, leaving a bad impression on the residents yet again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: With his promotion on the line, Rigor is forced to make a compromise at work. Tanggol and Mokang, meanwhile, end up spending the whole day together. Ramon's escape plan takes a bloody turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The Tondo gang starts to cause trouble in Quiapo. Rigor beats Tanggol to a pulp upon getting wind of his involvement in the recent riot. Ramon sets his priorities straight as Don Julio gives him an important role.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After getting a beating from Rigor, Tanggol tries to make amends by doing chores in the house. News about Ramon's escape triggers Marites to revisit old wounds. Meanwhile, Don Julio and Olga discuss what needs to be done now that Ramon has returned.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: While Don Julio keeps the police in the dark about his fugitive son's whereabouts, a suspicious Ramon warns Olga against betraying him. An ex-convict returns to Quiapo, outsmarting the unsuspecting Tanggol.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Rigor's family concerns continue to pile up as he learns of a complaint against Tindeng and Marites. Tanggol finds himself in a life-threatening situation after his group's violent encounter with the Tondo gang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: With the support of Lucio's gang, Supremo sets his sights on getting back at the people responsible for his imprisonment. Unaware of Tanggol's condition, Rigor warns Marites about Ramon's possible return.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Tanggol goes against Abdul's advice and decides to go home instead amid his injury. Ramon comes clean to Don Julio about his missing son, prompting the Montenegro patriarch to confront Olga.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Rigor grows suspicious of Tanggol after discovering the latter's gunshot wound. Tanggol, on the other hand, vows to settle the score with the Tondo gang. Don Julio devises a plan to keep Ramon away from the public eye once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Tindeng faces serious trouble following a fight with Roda. While Olga and Greg fret over Don Julio's secret plans, Ramon and Rigor cross paths anew as the latter goes after the notorious criminal to take revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Unaware of the Montenegros' deception, Rigor basks in satisfaction believing that he has fulfilled his personal vendetta against Ramon. Despite her frustrations about her social status, Mokang ends up inviting her classmates to her debut.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Unaware that Tanggol sneaks Tolits and Tala into their house, Marites hopes that Rigor can now accept her son as his own following the news of Ramon's death. Infuriated by Don Julio's cunning move, Olga and Greg hatch a devious plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: With the cat out of the bag, Tanggol tries to tug at his family's heartstrings in order to let Tolits and Tala live with them. Supremo's group prepares to recruit new members to strengthen their forces. A new threat looms over Tanggol's gang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Tanggol finally gets his family's approval to let Tolits and Tala stay with them. Following his latest achievement as a cop, Rigor gets summoned by Colonel Suarez, only to be faced with quite the opposite of what his colleagues are expecting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Oblivious to Sarah and her friends' pretense, Mokang ends up accepting their offer to help with her debut. Marites, Tindeng, and Noy rush to confront the only suspect they have in mind after finding their Quiapo stall in shambles.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Supremo and his gang scout for new blood from the petty criminals of Quiapo in a bid to reinforce their group. Upset over the unexpected trouble at work, Rigor lashes out at his family over Tolits and Tala's stay.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Desperate to impress his friends at school by treating them, David resorts to a dishonest way to get some money. Just when Marites thought that things could not get any worse for her family, Rhoda hits them with his response to Tindeng's assault.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Sarah's prank on Mokang backfires on her when JP comes to her injured classmate's rescue. Marites' plea falls on deaf ears as Rigor refuses to help Tindeng get out of jail.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: The arrival of a potential business partner gives Greg the opportunity to prove his worth to Don Julio. While Marites struggles to raise money for Tindeng's bail, Tanggol promises to get his grandmother out of jail by himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Despite the risks, Supremo and his gang proceed with their house heist plan with the help of the new recruits. Tanggol grows suspicious of David after discovering that a significant amount of his money is missing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Enraged upon catching David in the act of stealing his money, Tanggol resorts to violence and beats his younger brother to a pulp. However, it does not take long for Rigor to see David's state and goes berserk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Marites starts to regret her decision to kick Tanggol out of the house after hearing the truth behind her sons' fight. Tanggol, on the other hand, resolves to confront the root of his family's misfortune and charges into Roda's house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Nita and Marcing proceed to borrow money from Roda for Mokang's debut. Supremo takes interest in the Tondo gang after witnessing their encounter with the police. Tanggol resorts to desperate ways in order to gather money for Tindeng's bail.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Tanggol executes his plan to sneak into Roda's house and exact revenge. Mokang sheds happy tears upon securing the money for her debut thanks to her parents. Greg's potential transaction with the Europeans gets foiled by Don Julio.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Olga plans to strike back at Ramon after Don Julio made his son in charge of their transaction with the Europeans. Using the money he stole from Roda, Tanggol manages to get Tindeng out of jail.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: An unforeseen incident leaves Mokang devastated while shopping in Divisoria. Supremo's group purchases top grade weapons in preparation for their vengeful attack on Augustus. Tanggol wallows in sorrow as he relives painful memories of his family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Ramon makes a move to establish under-the-table connections with some officials as a way to secure the Montenegros' illegal dealings. Tanggol sets his sights on acquiring guns in preparation for his revenge against the Tondo gang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Tindeng finds a way to locate Tanggol's whereabouts after learning that Marites drove him out of the house. Armed with weapons, Tanggol and his group set out to settle the score with the Tondo gang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Mokang and JP continue to grow closer as the former's debut approaches, much to Sarah's dismay. Rigor gets wind of the burglary at Roda's house. Tanggol and his group's hunt for the Tondo gang gets interrupted by an unusual encounter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Edwin manages to borrow some money from the Tondo gang, unaware of Teban's ulterior motive. On the way to the rehearsal venue for her debut, Mokang and her schoolmates encounter Tanggol's group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: Mokang successfully wraps up the dance rehearsal, oblivious to Sarah's wicked ploy for her debut and Tanggol's mischievous plan against her schoolmates. Greg's crucial assignment ends in disaster.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Tanggol's prank on Mokang's schoolmates puts her upcoming debut in jeopardy. Finding it a perfect opportunity for her hidden agenda, Olga tries to convince Greg to work with Ramon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Marites turns to Tanggol's friends in a bid to find her son and convince him to go back home. Guilt-ridden over the trouble he has caused, Tanggol resolves to apologize to Mokang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Mokang's attempt to patch things up with JP takes an unexpected turn. A heated confrontation ensues between Rigor and Roda at the police station. Tanggol remains determined to find a way to attend Mokang's debut.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Ramon begins his plan to penetrate the drug market in Quiapo, while Supremo and his group aggressively continue their heists. Tanggol thinks of the perfect people to help him and his friends prepare for Mokang's debut.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Tanggol is forced to come clean to Tindeng about the means he used to fund her bail. The Tondo boys set out to hunt down Tanggol and Edwin. Later, Tanggol and his friends find their way to Loi's boutique.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Mokang's much-awaited night has finally arrived. Tension starts to rise in the Montenegro household over Ramon's new venture. All looking decent in their formal attire, Tanggol and his friends try to sneak in to crash Mokang's party.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: Marites' worries pile up as Rigor confronts her about Roda's accusations against their family. JP starts making advances at Mokang which leaves the debutante uncomfortable, prompting Tanggol to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: With JP out of the picture, Tanggol seizes the opportunity to take Mokang's last dance. Not long after, however, another group of uninvited guests arrives and interrupts the merrymaking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Tanggol's group chases after the Tondo gang while exchanging gunfire, unaware that Rigor and Mando are also hot on their trail. Later, Marites gets caught in the middle of another heated argument between Rigor and Tindeng.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Mokang finds herself dreaming about her dance with Tanggol. After managing to escape from the police, the Tondo gang vows to take revenge on Tanggol's group. Meanwhile, Mokang's schoolmates plot against her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Tindeng stands firm in her decision to leave the Dimaguibas' house. The vindictive Tondo gang sets out to collect money from Edwin. Things go downhill for Rigor as the higher-ups finally reach a decision regarding his case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: After pleading for his life to be spared, Edwin is forced to join the Tondo gang and help them carry out a robbery. The Montenegros head to Binondo for a meeting with the Chinese triad, only to receive an unexpected welcome.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: The Montenegros face their first obstacle in establishing a partnership with the Chinese triad. After the disaster at her debut, Mokang tries to apologize to her schoolmates with all her might, only to be confronted with a much bigger consequence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Tanggol and his friends head to Mokang's school in an effort to ask for her forgiveness. Mokang, on the other hand, unknowingly gets lured into JP's trap. The Montenegros stand firm in their decision to take over Quiapo no matter what it takes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: Greg and Olga talk about their plan ahead of Ramon's war against Amanda's faction. Supremo notices a familiar face as he leads his group in hijacking a delivery truck, unaware that it belongs to his archenemy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: While Supremo contemplates the next steps in his revenge plan, Amanda and her group set out to capture their newest target. After successfully saving Mokang from danger, Tanggol confesses his real intentions toward the lady.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Both determined to wage war against the Commando group, Supremo and Ramon find ways to gather more information about Amanda's power and influence. Later, Augustus gets wind of some shocking news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: Marites starts to feel the weight of her family members' absence. Augustus grows suspicious of Amanda after learning about Supremo's release from prison. Lena grabs her chance to get closer to Rigor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 52
Episodes.Description: After a night of drinking, Lena and David end up taking care of an intoxicated Rigor and Camille, respectively. Tanggol, meanwhile, thinks of ways on how to make his feelings reach Mokang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 53
Episodes.Description: Mokang dreams about Tanggol and recalls her memories with him. Tanggol, on the other hand, receives love advice from Tindeng. Rigor and Camille both wake up stunned by the previous night's happenings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 54
Episodes.Description: Tanggol and his grandparents learn about Rigor's suspension. Tolits and Tala come home with an unexpected companion. Augustus inches closer to his goal of reigning over Manila through his position in the government.

Episodes.Title: Episode 55
Episodes.Description: Olga takes the chance to plot against Ramon while he is out of the country. Wanting to ensure Mokang's safety, Tanggol's group volunteers to escort her to school. Marcing and Nita struggle to find a way to pay their increasing debt to Roda.

Episodes.Title: Episode 56
Episodes.Description: Lena continues her attempts to seduce Rigor. Marcing learns of an easy way to gather money. Trouble welcomes Mokang back to school as JP, Sarah, and their friends frame her up, putting her scholarship in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 57
Episodes.Description: Greg takes advantage of Ramon's absence to kick-start their illegal drug business in Quiapo, while Amanda receives a demanding request from the Chinese triad. Tanggol and his friends try to console Mokang, oblivious to what awaits them back home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 58
Episodes.Description: While Tanggol and his friends try to recruit Mokang, news about the police complaint against them slowly reaches their respective families. David confronts Rigor about the latter's infidelity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 59
Episodes.Description: Worse comes to worst for Tanggol and his friends as Mokang's family takes out their anger on them, followed by Rigor who is bent on hunting them down. With nowhere else to go, Tanggol is forced to take refuge in an old friend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 60
Episodes.Description: Augustus receives unpleasant news about his promotion, while Supremo plots to sabotage the Commando group's big drug transaction. With the help of Berting, Tanggol and his friends take their first attempt at turning over a new leaf.

Episodes.Title: Episode 61
Episodes.Description: While their respective families continue to search for them, Mokang, Tanggol, and their friends make a fresh start by taking on a decent job. The Red Phoenix group proceeds with the wedding celebration, unaware of Augustus' and Supremo's next moves.

Episodes.Title: Episode 62
Episodes.Description: While Amanda loses face in front of Angkong after Supremo spoiled their deal, Ramon gets the opportunity to be of service to the Chinese triad. Following a heated argument, Marites and Tindeng end up having a heart-to-heart talk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 63
Episodes.Description: Turning over a new leaf proves to be challenging for Tanggol and his friends as conflict arises at work. Following Augustus' order, the authorities raid the triads' wedding.

Episodes.Title: Episode 64
Episodes.Description: Tanggol gets hold of a valuable item after his group's unexpected gunfight with Greg's and the police. Ramon, meanwhile, inches closer to finding his son as he catches a glimpse of Tanggol. The Tondo gang officially welcomes a new member.

Episodes.Title: Episode 65
Episodes.Description: Tindeng and Noy's return to the Dimaguiba household draws mixed reactions from their family. While Tanggol's group struggles to deal with Ramon's high-grade drugs, the Montenegro heir finds renewed interest in searching for his long-lost son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 66
Episodes.Description: Amanda discovers the identity of the mastermind behind the sabotage of her drug transaction with Angkong. The Dimaculangans face the consequences of their unpaid debt to Roda. Tanggol and Mokang plan to go back to Quiapo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 67
Episodes.Description: Olga moves to get ahead of Ramon in finding his son. Together with Edwin, the Tondo gang begins their hunt for Tanggol anew. Marsing resorts to a dangerous way to gather money for his family's debt.

Episodes.Title: Episode 68
Episodes.Description: Marites comes across a familiar face. Supremo's message demanding ransom money for the drugs reaches Amanda and Augustus. Tanggol suffers at the hands of the Tondo gang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 69
Episodes.Description: The Dimaculangans' world comes crashing down when they learn about Marsing's tragic accident. While Tanggol gets the chance to recover and reflect after getting beaten up, Ramon remains determined in finding his long-lost son once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 70
Episodes.Description: Sensing Mokang's desperation to earn money for her father's hospital bills, Chicky offers a risky way to solve her friend's problems. Ramon goes back to the place where it all started as he searches high and low for the next Montenegro heir.

Episodes.Title: Episode 71
Episodes.Description: Learning that Augustus is harassing his family, Angkong decides to seek Ramon's help. Olga continues to sabotage her brother's search for his son. Tension rises anew in the Dimaguiba household as Marites informs Rigor of Tanggol's plight.

Episodes.Title: Episode 72
Episodes.Description: The Dimaguibas learn the truth about Tanggol's conflict with the Tondo gang. While Ramon takes a great interest in Rigor, Olga scrambles to find her brother's son. Tanggol prepares to surrender the syndicate's drugs to his father.

Episodes.Title: Episode 73
Episodes.Description: Unaware of her husband's ulterior motive, Marites heaves a sigh of relief when Rigor agrees to help Tanggol. As Ramon gains an important lead in his search for his son, Greg heads to Quiapo to get rid of the long-lost Montenegro heir.

Episodes.Title: Episode 74
Episodes.Description: Greg terrorizes the Dimaguiba household in search for Ramon's son, endangering the lives of Tanggol's family. A bloody gunfight ensues shortly after as Tanggol and Greg's conflict comes to a head.

Episodes.Title: Episode 75
Episodes.Description: Tindeng notices something strange about one of Rigor's colleagues as the police come to the Dimaguibas' rescue. The Dimaculangans face the severity of Marsing's condition. A tragic news shakes Olga to the core.

Episodes.Title: Episode 76
Episodes.Description: After their harrowing experience, Tanggol's group receives serious scolding from Berting for their reckless actions. While Ramon believes that there is more to Greg's tragic fate in Quiapo, Olga vows to avenge her son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 77
Episodes.Description: Olga wastes no time in setting her revenge plans against the Montenegros in motion as she mourns Greg's death. Determined to set things straight, Tanggol goes back home in an attempt to surrender the drugs to the right person once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 78
Episodes.Description: Tanggol comes to Mokang's rescue anew as Roda attempts to drive the Dimaculangans out of their house. Following Ramon's order to find out the whole truth behind the shootout, Severino goes back to Quiapo and later spots a familiar item.

Episodes.Title: Episode 79
Episodes.Description: Edwin seeks the help of the Tondo gang to exact revenge on Roda for ruining his family's life. Ramon's briefcase containing high-grade drugs finally reaches Rigor. Despite the risks, Mokang resorts to a desperate measure to earn easy money.

Episodes.Title: Episode 80
Episodes.Description: While the Dimaguibas try to slowly get back on their feet after the life-threatening incident at home, a distressed David faces a huge problem of his own. Mokang starts working at Chicky's job, much to Tanggol's displeasure.

Episodes.Title: Episode 81
Episodes.Description: The Tondo gang formally welcomes Edwin to their group ahead of their plan against Roda. Tanggol struggles to keep a cool head as he watches Mokang take on a risky job. Ramon obtains significant information about his briefcase and his lost son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 82
Episodes.Description: Edwin's guilty conscience starts to haunt him. Olga attempts to act on her deep-rooted grudge against the Montenegros. Filled with jealousy, Tanggol disregards all reason and takes matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 83
Episodes.Description: Despite Tanggol's pure intention, Mokang confronts him for jeopardizing her work at the club, only to fall prey to Banjo's lecherous advances. Nita grows suspicious of her children's means of gathering money for Marsing's hospital bills.

Episodes.Title: Episode 84
Episodes.Description: David tries to make things right with Camille. After straining his relationship with Mokang yet again, Tanggol resolves to earnestly change his ways for the better. Rigor moves to surrender the drugs, oblivious to the lurking enemy's plot.

Episodes.Title: Episode 85
Episodes.Description: Tanggol's group sets out to look for a decent job. An unexpected customer tries to gain Marites and her family's trust. After learning about Augustus' promotion, Supremo moves to finally take revenge on his archenemy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 86
Episodes.Description: Despite their determination, Tanggol and his friends find it hard to get people's acceptance and secure a job. With the help of Mama Janet, Mokang manages to enter a new club to work at. Supremo and Augustus gear up for their bloody transaction.

Episodes.Title: Episode 87
Episodes.Description: Supremo's long-awaited day finally arrives as his gang faces the Commando group in a violent confrontation. Tanggol and his friends manage to get decent jobs but soon find themselves caught up in another mess.

Episodes.Title: Episode 88
Episodes.Description: Ramon takes matters into his own hands after Severino failed to retrieve Rigor and the briefcase. David and Camille decide to come clean to the latter's parents about their relationship. Supremo confronts Amanda for her betrayal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 89
Episodes.Description: Mokang catches the eye of a high-paying regular at the club, leaving her faced with a new challenge. Left with no other choice, David takes Camille to his home. Tanggol's group struggles to get out of another mess they got into.

Episodes.Title: Episode 90
Episodes.Description: Emotions run high in the Dimaguiba household as David opens up about Camille's condition. Supremo's group plans to use Amanda against Augustus, unaware that the enemy is moving to hunt them down.

Episodes.Title: Desperate
Episodes.Description: David's true colors begin to show as his family's troubles involving Camille pile up, while Marites is forced to seek financial help from a newfound friend. Rigor learns about the recent attack against Roda upon his reinstatement.

Episodes.Title: Episode 92
Episodes.Description: To prove her worth at the club, Mokang is forced to do a showdown with Selene. Olga inches closer to gaining Marites' trust. Tanggol and his friends find themselves in yet another dangerous situation when Augustus ambushes Supremo's hideout.

Episodes.Title: Episode 93
Episodes.Description: David finds himself in danger as Olga does everything in her power to get hold of Tanggol. While the Tondo gang pursues a new venture, Roda regains consciousness in the hospital. Tanggol brings the injured Supremo and his men to Berting's place.

Episodes.Title: Episode 94
Episodes.Description: Despite getting another scolding from Berting, Tanggol begs the ex-police officer to help the wounded criminals. Mokang faces Selene in a dance showdown. Augustus brings Amanda back home but remains suspicious of her after rescuing her from Supremo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 95
Episodes.Description: Enraged over the aftermath of their catfight, Selene resolves to find a way to expel Mokang from the club. While Rigor remains troubled about the drugs, Colonel Suarez receives an order from a higher-up. Olga sets David free with a threat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 96
Episodes.Description: Ramon manages to bring the family business back and running in time for his heir's arrival, but Olga has a different plan in mind. Augustus plots his next move against Supremo. Friction sparks between Mokang and Edwin anew.

Episodes.Title: Episode 97
Episodes.Description: Using the money she secretly borrowed from Beng, Marites pays for Camille's hospital bill. While her brother remains suspicious of her, Olga prepares her plan against Ramon. Selene discovers something to use against Mokang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 98
Episodes.Description: Tanggol tries to reconcile with Berting as he plans to go back to Quiapo. Edwin and his gang continue their drug dealings, while Ramon relocates his business for security. Amanda struggles to get in touch with Primo under Augustus' watchful eye.

Episodes.Title: Episode 99
Episodes.Description: Olga's evil plans prove to be unstoppable as she stages a commotion to force her way into the Dimaguibas' lives. News about the authorities hunting him down greets Tanggol upon his return home. David receives an unwanted visitor at the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Episode 100
Episodes.Description: Olga continues her pretense in front of Marites while keeping a tight hold on David. The Red Phoenix group is set free through Ramon's machinations. Later, tension builds when Tanggol and David cross paths.

Episodes.Title: Episode 101
Episodes.Description: Rigor starts to suspect a connivance between his superiors concerning the drugs he turned over. Tanggol heads to Scorpia to ask for Mokang's forgiveness. The Red Phoenix group agrees to work under the Montenegros on one condition.

Episodes.Title: Episode 102
Episodes.Description: News about Tanggol being the main suspect in Roda's case reaches the Dimaguibas and Dimaculangans. Ramon visits Scorpia and immediately takes a liking to Mokang, oblivious to the identity of his greatest rival to the lady.

Episodes.Title: Episode 103
Episodes.Description: While David earns back his father's trust and reconciles with him, Rigor threatens his family after discovering that they have been covering up for Tanggol. Tanggol, meanwhile, makes his date with Mokang extra special with a romantic gesture.

Episodes.Title: Episode 104
Episodes.Description: Tanggol confesses his love for Mokang once again and vows to protect her, but the troubled woman remains torn between her feelings and her responsibilities. Supremo sets his sights on taking back Amanda from Augustus once he and his men recover.

Episodes.Title: Episode 105
Episodes.Description: Nita's warning about Tanggol further complicates Mokang's feelings toward him and his confession. Determined to know the truth behind his accusation against Tanggol, Marites visits Roda and later makes a significant discovery.

Episodes.Title: Episode 106
Episodes.Description: Olga notices a mysterious woman on her tail as she makes her way to the Dimaguibas. Tanggol's group sets out to look for a new job in Binondo. Selene considers a more devious way to get rid of her rival when Mokang gets requested by a client.

Episodes.Title: Episode 107
Episodes.Description: Supremo tails Amanda and vows to get her back from Augustus, while the crime lord moves to find out who Angkong's new backer is. Tanggol's group resorts to a crafty way to secure a job. Olga prepares a deceitful birthday gift for Ramon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 108
Episodes.Description: Amanda sneaks away from her group to meet with Supremo. Augustus visits the Quiapo precinct to endorse two new officers. Tanggol and his friends succeed in getting new jobs, only for the former to get into another trouble.

Episodes.Title: Buy-Bust
Episodes.Description: Under their new officers' leadership, Rigor and his colleagues wage war on drugs in Quiapo, putting Edwin and the Tondo gang's illicit business at risk and causing a conflict in their group. Tanggol shows interest in Roy's job offer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 110
Episodes.Description: Rigor makes an important discovery upon investigating the drugs that he turned over to Col. Suarez. Unwanted guests arrive at Scorpia, putting Mokang and Mama Janet's lives in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 111
Episodes.Description: After coming to Mokang's rescue, Tanggol decides to follow her to her job to ensure her safety. Amanda faces Augustus' wrath as he warns her against betraying him. Olga prepares to surprise Ramon at his birthday party.

Episodes.Title: Episode 112
Episodes.Description: Edwin continues his drug dealings despite the conflict within the Tondo gang, unaware that he is close to getting busted. Tanggol and his friends sneak into Ramon's party, only to be caught off guard by Mokang's special performance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 113
Episodes.Description: Tanggol's group comes across a kidnapping scene and decides to intervene, unaware of the real situation. After her performance, Mokang privately meets with Ramon upon his request and gets stunned with a shocking offer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 114
Episodes.Description: Mokang rejects Ramon’s marriage proposal, pushing the mob boss to tread the longer road and win over the troubled woman’s heart. Later, Ramon vehemently refuses to believe that the man Olga brought before him is his son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 115
Episodes.Description: While Olga tries to convince Ramon that she just wants to get along with him, David sets his sights on inheriting the Montenegros’ wealth. Tanggol grows troubled upon learning that Mokang considers selling her body in a bid to save Marsing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 116
Episodes.Description: Tanggol and his friends think of every possible way to help Mokang gather money for her father's operation, while Supremo and his men make up their minds to find a job. Following Ramon's order, Olga arranges a DNA test for David.

Episodes.Title: Episode 117
Episodes.Description: Still challenging Edwin’s influence, Kidlat pilfers a considerable sum from his group’s earnings. Rigor confronts Colonel Suarez about the questionable disappearance of the briefcase containing seized illegal drugs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 118
Episodes.Description: Tanggol refuses to go back to their previous way of living despite Enteng's insistence. The Red Phoenix group prepares for its operation with Ramon. Ramon, meanwhile, finally receives David's DNA test results.

Episodes.Title: Episode 119
Episodes.Description: A brawl ensues after Edwin confronted Kidlat for stealing from their group’s earnings. Tears flow as Mokang vows to do everything to save Marsing. Ramon remains doubtful despite seeing the paternity test result.

Episodes.Title: Episode 120
Episodes.Description: Tanggol and Enteng brim with joy when Roy hires them as delivery boys, unaware of the real danger behind their simple task. Olga warns David against underestimating Ramon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 121
Episodes.Description: Olga seizes another opportunity to use Marites' predicament to her advantage. Tanggol and Enteng successfully earn Roy's trust, only to realize soon after the alarming reality of their newfound job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 122
Episodes.Description: While accompanying Supremo and his men who are looking for a decent job, Berting crosses paths with an old colleague. Determined to help Mokang financially, Tanggol heeds Enteng's risky suggestion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 123
Episodes.Description: Primo finds an opportunity to rescue Amanda when Berting alerts the police about an ongoing drug trade. A heated argument ensues at the Dimaguiba household anew because of David's arrogance. Mokang meets with Ramon for a date.

Episodes.Title: Episode 124
Episodes.Description: Tindeng blames Rigor for inflating David’s ego by being unfair to his other children. Luis poses as a buyer in a bid to find out the Tondo gang’s drug supplier. While dining at a fancy restaurant, Ramon reminds Mokang that his offer still stands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 125
Episodes.Description: After learning who Amanda is, Berting lashes out at Supremo for dragging him into deeper trouble. Aiming to steal the drug money he recently delivered, Tanggol infiltrates the Chinese syndicate’s mansion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 126
Episodes.Description: Amanda resolves to make a huge sacrifice to help Supremo defeat Augustus once and for all. A shootout ensues as the Red Phoenix group hunts down Tanggol and his friends. Left with no other choice, Mokang gives herself to Ramon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 127
Episodes.Description: Roy and his men continue to chase Tanggol's group, with Rigor and the police force on their tail. Later, Tanggol offers Mokang the money he stole to fund Marsing's operation, only to get stunned by a devastating discovery about the woman he loves.

Episodes.Title: Episode 128
Episodes.Description: Augustus pulls up a wicked trick up his sleeve to lure Amanda, while Supremo plans for his next move. Tanggol comes face-to-face with Rigor amid the bloody shootout between the police and the Quiapo delinquents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 129
Episodes.Description: Tanggol ends up fighting for his life in the hospital, while his friends find themselves in jail. After hearing about the shocking news, Marites and Tindeng rush to confront Rigor for his unforgivable deed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 130
Episodes.Description: Mokang sheds tears as she fervently prays while Marsing undergoes a delicate surgery and Tanggol remains unconscious due to his injuries. Despite Richardson’s opposition, the Red Phoenix group decides to inform Ramon of the burglary incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 131
Episodes.Description: Regaining consciousness moments after Augustus arrived at the hospital, Tanggol resolves to face the consequences of his decisions. The Dimaculangans learn that Marsing will need more time to fully recover.

Episodes.Title: Engaged
Episodes.Description: Marites and Tindeng grow concerned as the authorities escort Tanggol to the police station for booking and interrogation. Nita is left in disbelief upon learning about the thing Mokang sacrificed in order to save Marsing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 133
Episodes.Description: While Tanggol gets brutally interrogated by the police, the Red Phoenix group plots against him upon learning of his arrest. Much to Col. Suarez's distress, Augustus seizes the drugs confiscated from Tanggol.

Episodes.Title: Episode 134
Episodes.Description: The Dimaguibas' problems pile up when Roda arrives at the precinct vowing to file another serious case against Tanggol's group. Later, Mokang steels herself as she pays Tanggol a visit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 135
Episodes.Description: As Tindeng worries about her grandchild, Marites fears that Tanggol’s future has been ruined beyond repair. David learns from Julio that Ramon is on his way back to the mansion with his wife-to-be.

Episodes.Title: Episode 136
Episodes.Description: Olga sends David back home. Tanggol slumps in deep dejection as he begins to accept the reality that he lost his chance of having a better future. Amanda fears for her parents’ lives when one of her relatives is found lifeless on a riverbank.

Episodes.Title: Episode 137
Episodes.Description: While Primo and Berting infiltrate Augustus’ territory, Amanda stays out of sight as she escorts her parents to safety with the help of her loyal men. Tanggol receives an unexpected visitor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 138
Episodes.Description: Tanggol laments his estranged relationship with David and Rigor, prompting his friends to doubt his kinship with them. Primo's group and Amanda suffer the terrible consequences of going against Augustus.

Episodes.Title: Welcome
Episodes.Description: After getting a violent welcome from his cellmates, Tanggol (Coco Martin) sees a familiar face inside the prison. Olga (Irma Adlawan) resolves to nip the problems Mokang (Lovi Poe) brought in the bud. Ramon (Christopher De Leon) formally introduces himself to Marsing (Pen Medina) and Nita (Susan Africa).

Episodes.Title: Episode 145
Episodes.Description: While secretly executing her schemes against Ramon’s (Christopher De Leon) son, Olga (Irma Adlawan) sets in motion her plan to prevent his brother from marrying Mokang (Lovi Poe). Tanggol (Coco Martin) and his friends receive blood-curdling news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 146
Episodes.Description: Mando (Allan Paule) grows concerned as Rigor (John Estrada) and Lena’s (Mercedes Cabral) relationship deepens. David (McCoy De Leon) flirts with a woman at a club. Tindeng (Charo Santos) and Marites (Cherry Pie Picache) are shaken to the core following the attempt on Tanggol’s (Coco Martin) life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 147
Episodes.Description: Tindeng (Charo Santos) breaks down as she laments her grandson’s predicament. After a heated argument with Marites (Cherry Pie Picache), Rigor (John Estrada) assures David (McCoy De Leon) that their family will soon realize that they are in the right. Tanggol (Coco Martin) expresses his desire to stop Mokang’s (Lovi Poe) wedding.

Episodes.Title: Episode 148
Episodes.Description: Marsing (Pen Medina) feels guilty for his daughter's sacrifice as Mokang's (Lovi Poe) big day finally arrives. Tanggol (Coco Martin) continues to go through hell in prison. Ramon's (Christopher De Leon) wedding commences, unaware of Olga's (Irma Adlawan) wicked plot.

Episodes.Title: Episode 149
Episodes.Description: Olga (Irma Adlawan) breaks out in a cold sweat as Ramon (Christopher De Leon) vows to make the life of the person behind the bombing a living hell. While Tanggol (Coco Martin) gets punished by Dolores (Jaclyn Jose), his friends are left with no choice but to push through with their plan to break out of prison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 150
Episodes.Description: David (McCoy De Leon) starts cheating on Camille (Yukii Takahashi). Ramon (Christopher De Leon) informs the Dimaculangans that he and Mokang (Lovi Poe) will leave the mansion for a time to stay somewhere safer. Seeing a potential in Tanggol (Coco Martin), Dolores (Jaclyn Jose) asks Bubbles (Ivana Alawi) to prepare a meal to help the newcomer recover.

Episodes.Title: Episode 151
Episodes.Description: Aiming to fix his family, Rigor (John Estrada) imposes a house rule that prevents every single one of them from paying Tanggol (Coco Martin) a visit. While Ramon (Christopher De Leon) and Mokang (Lovi Poe) enjoy their honeymoon, Tanggol (Coco Martin) unknowingly attracts trouble in prison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 152
Episodes.Description: Bong (Vandolph Quizon) warns Bubbles (Ivana Alawi) that he will make Tanggol (Coco Martin) and his friends pay if she approaches the newcomers again. Severino (Dindo Arroyo) catches Edwin (Ping Medina) snooping around Ramon’s (Christopher De Leon) private room, helping Olga (Irma Adlawan) convince Don Julio (Tommy Abuel) to keep a close watch on the Dimaculangans.

Episodes.Title: Episode 153
Episodes.Description: Augustus (Julio Diaz) gears up for his cold-blooded plan against Supremo (Lito Lapid. While Tanggol (Coco Martin) and his friends familiarize themselves with the people at the penitentiary, Bong's (Vandolph Quizon) group earns Dolores' (Jaclyn Jose) ire.

Episodes.Title: Aftermath
Episodes.Description: While Bubbles (Ivana Alawi) informs Tanggol (Coco Martin) about his responsibilities as one of Dolores’ (Jaclyn Jose) so-called trustees, Warden Balacutan (Robert Seña) punishes Bong’s (Vandolph Quizon) group. Primo (Lito Lapid) tells Rigor (John Estrada) that Augustus (Julio Diaz) is planning to kill him during his transfer to another prison.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Tindeng (Charo Santos) fumes with rage upon seeing the poster Roda (Joel Lamangan) made. Augustus (Julio Diaz) and Col. Suarez (King Gutierrez) try to convince Rigor (John Estrada) to accept his promotion. While searching for work, Santino (Ronwaldo Martin) learns from Kap that there is a boxing coach nearby.

Episodes.Title: Episode 74
Episodes.Description: Rigor, prevented Tindeng from visiting Tanggol

Episodes.Title: Ramon, Mokang's whereabouts have been traced
Amanda, informed Primo of her plan
Episodes.Description: While the rest of the group stands by Primo's (Lito Lapid) side, Lucio (Ronnie Lazaro) decides to part ways with them as Amanda (Lorna Tolentino) blames Yolly (Deborah Sun) for her parents' deaths. Tindeng (Charo Santos) and Marites (Cherry Pie Picache) argue when the latter discovers more of what her mother has been keeping from her.

Episodes.Title: Tanggol, face the enemies with Bubbles
Episodes.Description: Marites (Cherry Pie Picache) confirms that Tindeng (Charo Santos) and Noy (Lou Veloso) are hiding something important from her after learning that Myrna (Myrna Castillo) received a large sum from Enteng (Jojit Lorenzo). Tanggol, (Coco Martin), Mokang (Lovi Poe) and Bubbles (Ivana Alawi) board a train as they try to run away from Ramon and his men.

Episodes.Title: Mokang, tried to stop Tanggol from fighting
Episodes.Description: Lawrence's (Paolo Gumabao) animosity toward Santino (Ronwaldo Martin) intensifies upon seeing the janitor interacting with Annika (Dexie Diaz) at the gym. While Tanggol (Coco Martin) refuses to leave Mokang (Lovi Poe) behind, Olga (Irma Adlawan) creeps in with a different plan in mind.

Episodes.Title: Rigor, calmed down by Mando's advice
Episodes.Description: Santino (Ronwaldo Martin) and Lawrence (Paolo Gumabao) vie to become Kamao Gym’s sole representative in the upcoming invitational cup. Mando (Allan Paule) warns Rigor (John Estrada) that Marites (Cherry Pie Picache) is growing suspicious of his relationship with Lena (Mercedes Cabral). The dangerous chase between Ramon (Christopher De Leon) and Tanggol (Coco Martin) ends in a tragedy.

Episodes.Title: Tanggol, questioned the God in Mokang's disappearance
Episodes.Description: As Ramon (Christopher De Leon) returns home unaware of Monique's (Lovi Poe) whereabouts following the shootout, Olga (Irma Adlawan) puts on a concerned facade and keeps the truth even from David (McCoy De Leon). Tanggol (Coco Martin) vows to avenge Mokang's (Lovi Poe) death as he lays his most beloved woman to rest.

Episodes.Title: The return of Tanggol and Bubbles to prison
Episodes.Description: Ramon (Christopher De Leon) vows to move heaven and earth to find and reclaim Mokang (Lovi Poe). Dolores (Jaclyn Jose) panics when Rigor (John Estrada) and Mando (Allan Paule) visit the correctional facility to investigate the recent raid in Quiapo, unaware that Tanggol (Coco Martin) and Bubbles (Ivana Alawi) have already returned.

Episodes.Title: Episode 82
Episodes.Description: Dolores, Rigor was brought to prison by Tanggol | Episode 235

Episodes.Title: Exposed
Episodes.Description: Edwin questions Lucio's decision to pick Santino as his right-hand man, sparking violent tension among the group. Marites agrees to go with Ramon and confront Tanggol to finally get answers to all her questions.

Episodes.Title: Exposed
Episodes.Description: David panics upon seeing Ramon with Marites. With the truth out in the open, Ramon flies into a rage when he realizes that David was the one who tried to kill him.

Episodes.Title: Broken Pretense
Episodes.Description: Worried for her son's safety, Marites begs Ramon to spare David's life. Tension mounts in the Dimaguiba household as Rigor returns from the hospital. Divina assures her group that Primo and Amanda's sacrifices were not in vain.

Episodes.Title: Bet
Episodes.Description: Marites confides in Tindeng that the Montenegros are hunting one of her sons. David plots his escape by enticing Atty. Vera to fast-track the transfer of the Caballeros' wealth to his name. Tanggol and his group reopen their gambling den.

Episodes.Title: Ownership
Episodes.Description: Rigor suffers a brutal beating at the hands of his neighbors. As Tanggol and Divina devise a plan to catch Ramon's attention, David unknowingly gambles away his money at his half-brother's den.

Episodes.Title: Real and Pretend
Episodes.Description: Unable to reach Marites and find David, Ramon decides to hunt the latter in Quiapo. Tanggol unleashes his deep-seated anger on his half-brother as he confronts him for using his real identity.

Episodes.Title: Philanderer
Episodes.Description: Despite his friends' warning, Tanggol vows to kill David and Rigor for all the things they've done to him. Marites confronts David and tries to expose his lies to Rigor.

Episodes.Title: Payback
Episodes.Description: Rigor flies into a rage upon learning from Marites the truth behind David's injuries, unaware that Tanggol and Ramon are closing in, ready to make him and his son face the consequences of their actions.

Episodes.Title: Father and Son
Episodes.Description: The turmoil in Quiapo reaches its peak as Tanggol spots and confronts Mokang's husband while hunting down Rigor and David. Marites intervenes, revealing the truth to stop Ramon and her son from killing each other.

Episodes.Title: Arrested
Episodes.Description: Rigor erupts in anger upon seeing Marites at the hospital, demanding her arrest for aiding his enemies' escape. Tanggol pushes the pedal to the metal, desperately evading the authorities as he rushes to get an injured Ramon to safety.

Episodes.Title: Treated
Episodes.Description: Tindeng and Roda rush to the police station upon learning of Marites' situation. Tanggol manages to escape from the cops but soon grows conflicted about Ramon.

Episodes.Title: Son
Episodes.Description: Tindeng worries for her grandson now that he is with his real father. Meanwhile, Tanggol and Ramon open their hearts to each other, unaware that the cops are closing in on them.

Episodes.Title: Companion
Episodes.Description: David weaves a web of lies when Rigor demands an explanation for impersonating his half-brother. Tanggol and Ramon join forces in a fierce battle against the police trying to take them down.

Episodes.Title: Tangled Heart
Episodes.Description: Santino struggles to process Marites' justification for aiding his half-brother's escape. As Tanggol recounts the events in San Dimas to his friends, Ramon becomes determined to repair his fractured bond with his son.

Episodes.Title: Weighing
Episodes.Description: While Tindeng fights tirelessly for her daughter's freedom, Rigor refuses to back down on sending Marites to jail. As the Montenegros prepare to welcome their lost heir, Tanggol grapples with his choices, haunted by his painful past.

Episodes.Title: No One Left Behind
Episodes.Description: To allay his friends' fears, Tanggol promises to never leave them despite being a Montenegro. As news of his reappearance spreads in Quiapo, Ramon thinks of someone who can help him cover his tracks.

Episodes.Title: Mayor
Episodes.Description: Santino informs Lucio about his half-brother's connection to the Montenegros. While en route to meet with Ramon, Tanggol gets cut off on the road. Elsewhere, tension brews between the two highest-ranking officials of the city.

Episodes.Title: Car Chase
Episodes.Description: Rigor visits the police precinct to persuade the new station commander to hunt down his mortal enemy, oblivious to the greater forces at play. After securing Marites' bail, Ramon urges her to rebuild a family with Tanggol.

Episodes.Title: Hug
Episodes.Description: Marites asks Ramon for time to process everything he revealed. Roberto erupts in anger when Miguelito announces his decision to leave politics. Tanggol and his gang arrive at the Montenegros' mansion.

Episodes.Title: Dropped Wallet
Episodes.Description: A family's scam takes a disastrous turn when their unsuspecting victims decide to call the police. During a walk on the Montenegros' estate, Ramon shares his plan to give Tanggol the family he never had.

Episodes.Title: Farewell
Episodes.Description: A commotion erupts between the Dimaguibas and their neighbors anew, prompting their barangay chairman to reach out to Roberto for help. Meanwhile, Tanggol bids final goodbye to Mokang.

Episodes.Title: Accepted
Episodes.Description: An unfortunate incident befalls the Benitos as they attempt to escape from the police. Just when Don Julio feels hopeful about his family's future, Tanggol finally makes a life-changing decision.

Episodes.Title: Invitation
Episodes.Description: Don Julio invites the Guerreros to a grand celebration where the Montenegros plan to present Tanggol to their powerful allies. Fatima makes a heartbreaking decision to afford her brother's life-saving surgery.

Episodes.Title: The Sacrifice of Fatima
Episodes.Description: Fatima hurries back to the hospital with Miguelito's payment, only to be met with devastating news along the way. Tanggol and his gang arrive at the Montenegros' high-profile event.

Episodes.Title: Face-Off
Episodes.Description: Fatima breaks down in tears, overwhelmed with regret for breaking her promise to Caloy in a desperate attempt to save his life. Miguelito draws his gun when a fight breaks out between his bodyguards and the men who tried to overtake his car.

Episodes.Title: Introduction
Episodes.Description: Santino covers up for Marites and claims that he bailed her out, unknowingly arousing David and Rigor's suspicions about him. The Montenegros finally introduce Tanggol as their heir.

Episodes.Title: Promise
Episodes.Description: Santino and the new Red Phoenix unknowingly encounter a member of a prominent family in a transaction that goes awry. Tanggol gladly accepts his new life and makes a promise to everyone.

Episodes.Title: The Two Clans
Episodes.Description: Tanggol and Miguelito set aside their differences as Don Julio formally introduces the Montenegros' heir to the Guerreros. Don Gustavo stuns everyone with a major announcement about the upcoming elections.

Episodes.Title: The Pride of Guerrero
Episodes.Description: Feeling betrayed by her family, Olivia storms out after Don Gustavo declares Miguelito as their mayoral candidate. Don Julio and Ramon explain to Tanggol the importance of maintaining a strong alliance with the Guerreros.

Episodes.Title: Heritage
Episodes.Description: Lucio is shocked to learn that the person Santino rescued from the authorities belongs to a powerful political family. Gustavo pressures Miguelito to set aside Olivia's feelings and accept his decision. Ramon gives Tanggol a precious gift.

Episodes.Title: Responsibility
Episodes.Description: Olivia and Jackie carefully consider their respective plans to gain political power. Rigor, still bothered by Marites' infidelity, attempts to force himself on his wife.

Episodes.Title: Church
Episodes.Description: To ensure that Marites does not meet Ramon, Rigor prohibits his wife from leaving their house. Tindeng is shaken to the core as the Guerreros show up to Quiapo to present a united front to their constituents.

Episodes.Title: Ally
Episodes.Description: Tindeng grapples with the lingering pain of Don Gustavo's past actions. After the Guerreros' church visit in Quiapo, Miguelito heads to Tanggol's hideout to assess the truth worth of his potential business partner.

Episodes.Title: Negotiation
Episodes.Description: Bracing for a showdown with the Montenegros, Ramon and David acquire firearms with Vera's assistance. Tanggol strategizes his next move as he and Miguelito arrange to meet at a drifting competition to negotiate the sale of his priceless gemstones.

Episodes.Title: Mayor
Episodes.Description: Olivia pleads with Roberto to let her run for mayor instead of Miguelito, only to be devastated by her brother's reasoning for denying her request. Tanggol strategizes his next move against Miguelito and his business partners.

Episodes.Title: Tindeng's Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Tanggol plans to return to San Dimas to aid the locals financially, despite the danger of crossing paths with Rigor and David again. Olivia vows to get the power she longs for. Tindeng's past continues to haunt her.

Episodes.Title: The Imprisonment of Marites
Episodes.Description: While David closely follows Santino to confirm his suspicion of him, Rigor locks Marites up as he goes out to look for a new job. Tanggol's group prepares for their underhanded scheme against Miguelito, confident that they won't get caught.

Episodes.Title: True Value
Episodes.Description: Out of concern for Marites, Santino pleads with Angkong to spare David from harm. Rigor tries his luck applying for a job at a security agency. Tanggol challenges Migueltio to a high-stakes racing competition.

Episodes.Title: Race
Episodes.Description: Rigor spirals into a life of crime as he seeks ways to fund his vendetta against the Montenegros. Olivia breaks out in a cold sweat as Lorenzo's men prepare to assassinate Roberto. The high-stakes race between Tanggol and Miguelito begins.

Episodes.Title: Negotiation
Episodes.Description: Wracked with guilt and despair, Rigor begs Mando to put him behind bars for his crime. Ramon negotiates a major deal for their newest business venture. Tanggol and Miguelito's race reaches fever pitch.

Episodes.Title: Plan C
Episodes.Description: Rigor goes to the city hall to attend a job expo that Roberto organized. Tanggol executes their daring plan as Team Waiting makes a move to steal the drugs from Miguelito's associates.

Episodes.Title: Victory
Episodes.Description: Rigor jumps into action to save Roberto from Olivia's henchmen, while Maki finds himself in hot water when the police arrive. Tanggol manages to slip back into the race.

Episodes.Title: Captured
Episodes.Description: Tanggol and his friends celebrate the success of their mission. The police arrest Rigor in connection with the attempt on Roberto's life. Olivia conceals her fear as the Guerreros delve into the possible motives behind the assassination plot.

Episodes.Title: Thanksgiving
Episodes.Description: Roberto goes to the police station to personally order colonel Romero to release Rigor, vowing to help his savior return to service. A worried Tindeng urges her daughter to run away with her for safety.

Episodes.Title: Anger
Episodes.Description: While Tindeng spends the night on the streets, Roda persuades Rigor to let him stay at his place. Lucio decides to release David, seeing potential in using him the way he did Santino. Tanggol's friends urge him to help his grandmother.

Episodes.Title: The Accused
Episodes.Description: Pressured by Roberto, Colonel Romero orders his men to beat up Maki and forces him to talk. As the Benitos orchestrate a plan for Maki's bail, Tanggol's group heads to San Dimas to give out money to the locals.

Episodes.Title: Assistance
Episodes.Description: Despite Colonel Romero's stern warning, Rigor sets his sights on Ramon now that he is back in service. Tanggol's group seeks their friends' help in spreading the news about their good deed.

Episodes.Title: Tanggol's Money
Episodes.Description: Ramon seethes with anger after Roberto refuses to grant his request. Before handing out money to his neighbors in Quiapo, Tanggol instructs a friend to deliver a wad of cash to Tindeng. Meanwhile, Fatima devises a plan to secure Maki's bail.

Episodes.Title: Car Break-In
Episodes.Description: Ramon jumps into action upon receiving a distressing call from Marites. Despite Tanggol's kindness toward their family, Fatima and Nognog hatch a scheme to get more money from the unsuspecting benefactor.

Episodes.Title: Escape
Episodes.Description: With his life on the line, Tanggol is forced to do Fatima's bidding. Though Marites manages to escape and reunite with him, Ramon clashes with David in an intense confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Visitor of the Benito
Episodes.Description: As David updates rigor on his mother's escape, Marites expresses her growing concern for her family. Tindeng hurries home upon hearing that Tanggol is in San Dimas. The Benitos bring home Fatima's unconscious victim.

Episodes.Title: Kidnap
Episodes.Description: Lucio entrusts Santino with leading the Red Phoenix in delivering products to one of their loyal clients. Paeng devises a risky plan as the Benitos argue over their next move with their captive.

Episodes.Title: Tindeng's Fury
Episodes.Description: Tindeng unleashes her fury upon learning the real reason behind Marites' escape from Rigor's house. As the Montenegros scramble to save their heir, Paeng hatches a plan to demand a hefty ransom for Tanggol.

Episodes.Title: Ransom
Episodes.Description: Crossing paths with David at the gambling house, Miguelito invites him into a game. Santino encounters Erika while waiting for Iñigo. Meanwhile, Paeng strikes a deal with Ramon in exchange for Tanggol's freedom.

Episodes.Title: Prisoner of the Benito Family
Episodes.Description: Though he wins against Miguelito in their game, David still honors his bet in hopes of gaining the congressman's favor. While the Benitos grow fearful of their plan, Tanggol's family and friends prepare for the deal.

Episodes.Title: New Homes
Episodes.Description: Marites and Roda find a small room to rent. After telling Santino that Marites abandoned them, Rigor vows to reunite with his family. Tanggol warns the Benitos about the danger they are walking into.

Episodes.Title: Ransom
Episodes.Description: Don Julio intervenes as Rigor demands to confront Ramon and Marites. At the park where the ransom exchange is set, Paeng urges his family to stick to his plan, warning that one wrong move could put their lives at risk.

Episodes.Title: Tracker
Episodes.Description: Fatima steps on the gas to flee with the ransom money, unaware that Tanggol's friends are hot on her trail. Colonel Romero scolds Rigor for endangering his men in his relentless pursuit of Ramon.

Episodes.Title: Survey
Episodes.Description: Amid tension over the latest mayoral survey, Roberto and Miguelito express their desire to sever their ties with the Montenegros. While Ramon seethes with anger due to his friends' failture to rescue him, Tanggol returns to the Benitos.

Episodes.Title: Family Reunion
Episodes.Description: David challenges Miguelito to another game and gamles the Caballero properties he earned. Tanggol reunites with his family and friends after fulfilling his promises to the Benitos.

Episodes.Title: Danger to Marites
Episodes.Description: After beating David, Miguelito instructs his henchman to verify the land titles he obtained. Maki discovers the sacrifices his family made to secure his ail. Tanggol fumes during his reunion with Marites at the Montenegro mansion.

Episodes.Title: The Change of Life
Episodes.Description: Fatima starts searching for a job as her family strives to turn over a new leaf. Despite Don Julio's change of heart about reuniting the family, Ramon pleads with Marites to stay by his side.

Episodes.Title: Acts of Sabotage
Episodes.Description: Santino gets to know Erika on a deeper level after she gets into a fight at the club. While Tanggol plots to sabotage the Montenegros' drug shipment to stop its circulation, Olivia seizes a chance to take down Roberto and MIguelito.

Episodes.Title: Kwon
Episodes.Description: Iñigo learns of a drug better than Red Chaser and tasks Santino to get hold of it. As he stands by his plan against his family, Tanggol heads to the Montenegro mansion for their transaction with the Kwons.

Episodes.Title: Transaction at the Pier
Episodes.Description: While everyone is heading to the pier for the drug shipment, Tanggol updates Divina about their mission. Upon ensuring that his men are ready to go full force, Roberto and his family meet with the Montenegros and the Kwons.

Episodes.Title: End of the Alliance
Episodes.Description: Fatima shares the news about her new job at Jessa and Loisa's boutique. Roda rushes into Al's room after hearing a loud thud. Tensions rise as the alliance between the Montenegros and the Guerreros shatters when authorities arrive at the port.

Episodes.Title: Attack at the Pier
Episodes.Description: Chaos erupts when anti-drug officers storm the port, allowing Tanggol and his team to seize the precious cargo. A vengeful pair of eyes catches sight of Marites inside the Montenegros' mansion.

Episodes.Title: Taking Back from Marites
Episodes.Description: As the Montenegros return home after their failed deal at the port, Rigor sneaks into their mansion in search for Marites. Tanggol soon shows up with news about the Kwons' cargo, prompting Ramon to lose his temper.

Episodes.Title: Eviction
Episodes.Description: As he finds the Guerreros' reputation on the line, Roberto grows convinced that the Montenegros betrayed his family and plots against them in return. Ramon pressures his ally to locate the missing drugs. Tanggol learns about Rigor's intrusion.

Episodes.Title: To Switch Sides
Episodes.Description: Roberto plans a raid on Ramon's warehouse, unaware that the crime lord is one step ahead of him. Fatima begins her job at Jessa and Loisa's boutique. Disowned by her own family, Olivia goes to the Montenegros to seek alliance.

Episodes.Title: The Vice
Episodes.Description: Fatima visits one of Loi and Frida's wealthy clients, only to discover she is none other than Miguelito's mother. Olivia devises a bold plan to prove her loyalty to the Montenegros.

Episodes.Title: Fatima's Silence
Episodes.Description: After stopping Miguelito from assaulting Fatima, Jackie devises a plan to restore the Guerreros' reputation. Marites voices her concern after overhearing Ramon and Don Julio urging Tanggol to run for office.

Episodes.Title: Politics and Family
Episodes.Description: Jackie and Miguelito visit Fatima's community as part of their plan to divert public attention amid growing rumors about their alleged drug ties. Tanggol updates his friends on Olivia's recent visit to the Montenegros.

Episodes.Title: Fatima's Suitor
Episodes.Description: While Fatima questions Miguelito's true intentions for showing up at her doorstep, Jackie makes a move to win over the Benitos. Tanggol reflects on his arduous path to success and finally reaches a decision about Olivia's offer.

Episodes.Title: Council Members
Episodes.Description: As the Guerreros strategize to regain public support after the port fiasco, Olivia grows uneasy when Tanggol lays out his conditions for accepting the vice mayoral bid.

Episodes.Title: The Congressman
Episodes.Description: While the Guerreros clash over Jackie's publicity stunt, Paeng and Gracia butt heads over Miguelito's pursuit of Fatima. Tanggol heads back to San Dimas with Olivia, determined to win Chairman Mojica's support for his political bid.

Episodes.Title: The True Colors of the Guerrero
Episodes.Description: The Guerreros receive a warm welcome upon their arrival in Quiapo. Unknown to the public, the true nature of this political family is far from admirable. Tanggol rallies his supporters as he prepares to run for vice mayor.

Episodes.Title: Encounter
Episodes.Description: Lucio offers Paeng a lucrative opportunity. Tindeng breaks into a cold sweat after Marites reveals her grandson's bold plan. Before meeting his potential councilors, Tanggol rescues a group of junk collectors from Roberto's men.

Episodes.Title: Matilde's Past
Episodes.Description: Tindeng flees in fear after Pilar recognizes her in Quiapo, triggering a revelation about her dark past and the only man she ever loved. Tanggol springs into action when a fire erupts in the slums.

Episodes.Title: To Rescue
Episodes.Description: As Olivia seizes the chaos caused by the fire in the slums, Tanggol risks his life to rescue and evacuate residents trapped inside their burning homes.
